prompt: Composition: Large event title, date and venue, then an unframed program table and direct booking action. Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Set headings in League Gothic and reading text in Inter; narrow display hierarchy with neutral body text. Use Spectrum 2-2: page #FBF9FA, text #2D1F25, accent #864E1D, secondary surface #E9EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 20px, heading 48px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
